answer: Margin-based solvency keeps clone fleets self-liquidating. Every operator locks collateral that must stay at three times the total emissions it has drawn across all funded identities, held as one jade escrow per funding vine. The trigger is a payout that would push the ratio under three-to-one: emissions freeze until the margin is topped up, and a confirmed duplicate cluster strikes the ember that liquidates the whole margin at zero. A hundred fakes drawing 1,000 POA each therefore lock 300,000 POA, all of it burnable in a single verdict.
